# featbit_member (Data Source)

Reads one existing FeatBit Member by exact UUID or organization-scoped case-insensitive full email. It never invites, creates, updates, removes, or deletes the Member.

Configure exactly one selector: `id` for a UUID or `email` for an
organization-scoped, case-insensitive full-email match. Lookup consumes the
complete Member collection and rejects zero or duplicate exact matches; it
never selects a substring or first result. State retains the server's
canonical email spelling.

Only ID, email, and display name enter the provider model, and all three are
Sensitive. Invitation fields and initial passwords are not decoded. The data
source can supply an existing Member ID to a Group-Member binding or the
additive Member-Policy binding, or to the separate authoritative direct-Policy
resource, but it never invites, creates, changes, removes, or deletes the
Member.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "member_email" {
  description = "Organization-scoped full email of an existing FeatBit Member."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

data "featbit_member" "exact" {
  email = var.member_email
}
```

Treat Terraform state, plans, and terminal output as confidential.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String, Sensitive) Organization-scoped case-insensitive full Member email. Configure exactly one of `id` or `email`; state retains the server's canonical spelling.
- `id` (String, Sensitive) Exact Member UUID. Configure exactly one of `id` or `email`.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String, Sensitive) Server-reported Member display name.
